description: Search Valumech's read-only robot catalog by words, category, market status, or a maximum approximate USD price. At least one filter is required.

buyableOnly.description: When true, return only robots with dated in-stock or preorder buying evidence.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 through 10.

maxPriceUsd.description: Maximum new price normalized approximately to USD.

pricedOnly.description: When true, return only robots with a current sourced public price.

query.description: Robot, maker, capability, body form, or use-case words.

name: search_robot_catalog
title: Search robot catalog
